g.text: Private dictation for Mac. Pink and cobalt, on white.
Five bars. Cobalt, with the tall centre bar pink.
No tile, plate or border behind the standalone mark.
A white rounded square for macOS.
The same waveform geometry and inks.
The logo opens Cadence. Stats stay local.
Transparent SVG, PNG and multi-size ICO.
Solid inks keep the bars clear at 16 pixels.
